screens.name: Home
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows the settled Home and entry sample; supplied evidence reports proportional browser checks and a successful real reading flow.
findings: Give the unavailable omen a recovery action or clearer availability explanation beyond trying tomorrow.

screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent orb placement across approach samples, and supplied evidence describes a 650ms automatic advance.
findings: Verify that the brief automatic state does not interrupt assistive announcements or steal focus.

screens.name: Ask — normal
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled question field, voice alternative and prominent submission control; the supplied real drive completed question entry.
findings: Replace the technical phrase “prediction engine” with a plain explanation of how submitted information is used.

screens.name: Ask — 200% and constrained viewport
screens.evidence: Sheets 01 and 14 show enlarged question entry and a cropped question in the synthetic keyboard viewport, while supplied measurements report reachable submission.
findings: Verify native keyboard scrolling keeps the caret, useful question context and submission control reachable together.

screens.name: Listening — microphone unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows matching listening samples with a microphone failure notice, retry affordance and typing alternative.
findings: Change the failed-state invitation from “Speak your question” to an explicit retry or typing instruction.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show stable loading composition with purpose, expected duration, credit reassurance and Cancel.
findings: Verify loading announcements and cancellation focus recovery with a screen reader.

screens.name: Question card 1
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows the first question, four underlined answer rows and textual progress in both entry and settled samples.
findings: Use answer choices on one consistent scale, since “Nearly certain” measures confidence while “Barely started” measures progress.

screens.name: Question card 2
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show a consistent obstacle question layout with three concise options and custom entry.
findings: Verify that choosing an answer provides perceivable confirmation before advancing.

screens.name: Question card 3
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final support question with consistent spacing and explicit 3-of-3 progress.
findings: Make the transition from the final selection to prediction generation explicit to assistive users.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty and selected
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows the selected custom option, change-answer action, labeled empty field and disabled Continue.
findings: Add a short instruction that an answer is required so progression does not depend on interpreting the disabled button.

screens.name: Custom answer — 200% empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the enlarged question and selected option occupying most of the viewport, with the answer field beginning at the bottom.
findings: Reduce vertical spacing around the selected option and change-answer action to expose more of the input.

screens.name: Custom answer — 200% filled and constrained viewport
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows horizontally cropped entered text and a visible submit button; supplied browser checks report retained text and reachable actions.
findings: Use a wrapping answer field so enlarged responses remain reviewable without horizontal text scrolling.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows research-specific status, credit reassurance and Cancel, with stronger background smoke than planning.
findings: Keep moving smoke subdued behind status text throughout the loading interval.

screens.name: Reveal
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show a dim mid-entry forecast followed by a readable settled result, and supplied runtime evidence reports a completed real prediction.
findings: Use a quieter text backdrop and preserve readable forecast contrast throughout entry.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded explanation
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows an expanded explanation beneath the forecast, with long fixture text continuing below the viewport.
findings: Structure long explanations into short context, assumptions and uncertainty sections for easier scanning.

screens.name: Check-in
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 places outcome choices below the forecast, and supplied runtime evidence reports outcome saving and persistence.
findings: Show a clear selected outcome and saved confirmation beside the three response choices.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show a stable error composition with credit reassurance, Try again and Edit question.
findings: Verify that retry preserves the question and announces the renewed loading state.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to prediction recovery, and supplied runtime evidence reports recovery and credit invariants.
findings: Verify that reviewing answers after failure restores both prior selections and custom text.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — planning
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show support, alternate-question and edit actions plus explicit credit and memory reassurance.
findings: Give the support action greater visual priority than returning to entertainment.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — prediction
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows the prediction-stage redirect with consistent recovery options; supplied evidence reports a real sensitive redirect.
findings: Keep the support action visually prominent and verify its destination and focus behavior independently.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows an explicit empty state, device-local storage note and Ask the Ball action.
findings: Strengthen the empty-state action’s button affordance while retaining the restrained layout.

screens.name: History — populated and stress
screens.evidence: Sheets 06–07 show dated reading rows and a long-list sample, while supplied runtime evidence reports history persistence.
findings: Clarify what “Waiting” means and make each row’s open-detail affordance explicit.

screens.name: Sky — offline sample content
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 label offline sample stars, show Retry and connect the selected Love topic to a question and primary action.
findings: Add a non-color selected marker to the active star topic.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 announces offline availability before disabled circle creation and sharing controls.
findings: Place an explicit connection-required explanation next to the disabled creation control.

screens.name: You — empty memory and settings
screens.evidence: Sheets 13 and 15 show plan, empty memory and preferences; supplied evidence reports switch keyboard operation, focus visibility and persistence.
findings: Ensure the final privacy row can scroll fully clear of the protruding central navigation orb.

screens.name: You — 200% settings
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows enlarged preference labels and wrapped actions, with content partially hidden at the top and bottom of the captured scroll position.
findings: Verify enlarged content and focus targets remain unobscured by both the header and bottom navigation throughout scrolling.

screens.name: Plans — normal
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows explicit billing units, selected yearly pricing and test-mode purchases, with the orb partly clipped in the settled capture.
findings: Keep decorative content clear of the fixed header and clarify the relationship between the available reading and paid allowances.

screens.name: Plans — 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows stacked enlarged prices, a checkmarked yearly selection and a fully visible wrapped primary action.
findings: Verify that pack purchases and any lower-page terms remain equally reachable at enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: Share
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a story preview and image, video and private-link choices; supplied evidence verifies PNG export but leaves OS sharing unverified.
findings: Clarify who can access a private friend link before the user shares it.

screens.name: Story export
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows the full story card and export action, and supplied runtime evidence reports a real 1080×1920 PNG export and synthetic failure recovery.
findings: Keep Back to sharing fully discoverable below the export action at all supported viewport heights.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use the illustrated gold orb as the focal point, and Home pairs its interactive role with an instruction.
findings: Verify that interactive orbs expose a clear accessible action while decorative copies are ignored by assistive technology.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: The main screens show five labeled destinations, an underlined active tab and a raised central orb overlapping the content boundary.
findings: Reserve sufficient scroll clearance for the raised orb and verify enlarged navigation labels remain legible.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently show page identity and remaining daily readings, with supplied runtime evidence reporting balance invariants.
findings: Explain how daily allowance and purchased credits relate wherever the balance is presented.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream filled buttons provide consistent emphasis and wrap at 200%, while supplied browser drives report successful primary actions.
findings: Verify pressed, focused and disabled states across native input methods and enlarged text.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold or cream text actions appear throughout the sheets, sometimes with a row separator and sometimes without one.
findings: Standardize secondary-action hit areas and focus treatment so text links remain reliably discoverable.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question screens use spacious underlined rows, and custom selection adds both gold emphasis and a checkmark.
findings: Apply equally explicit selected-state feedback to ordinary answers before automatic progression.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Normal Ask screens show a labeled multiline serif field with a strong gold outline and separate submission action.
findings: Distinguish the ordinary field boundary from keyboard focus without adding competing outlines.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged captures show a readable multiline question but horizontally cropped custom-answer text; supplied synthetic viewport checks prove action reachability.
findings: Allow custom answers to wrap and test caret visibility with the real native keyboard.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Supplied control evidence reports 342×52px labeled targets, label click, Space, Enter, visible focus and reload persistence for all three preferences.
findings: Complete physical screen-reader and platform preference checks before raising the provisional grade.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 08 shows only an unavailable omen with an instruction to return tomorrow.
findings: Provide an actionable recovery route or explain why the user must wait until tomorrow.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheets 13–14 connect the gold Love star to a labeled sample question and Ask this too button.
findings: Supplement the selected star’s color change with a persistent shape or text indicator.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 places availability, privacy scope and disabled controls in a restrained borderless layout.
findings: Explain the disabled creation state immediately beside its control.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 06–07 separate date, original question, forecast and waiting status with consistent alignment and fine rules.
findings: Add a clearer detail-opening affordance and a more specific pending-outcome label.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 09 shows explicit month/year units, annual billing explanation and a checkmarked yearly selection in both text sizes.
findings: Verify both plan rows announce selection and billing terms as a coherent accessible control.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a coherent portrait card whose disclaimer and branding become very small in the reduced preview.
findings: Provide an accessible text equivalent and keep the uncertainty disclaimer legible at typical sharing sizes.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, voice, offline and sensitive states visibly explain the condition and offer contextual alternatives, supported by selected runtime recovery checks.
findings: Verify announcement timing and focus restoration for each notice rather than relying on visual presence.

components.name: Typography and spacing
components.evidence: The sheets consistently pair expressive serif headings with sans-serif controls, but small metadata and enlarged custom-entry layouts reduce readability.
findings: Increase small supporting-text legibility and tighten enlarged-form spacing without reducing text size.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The dark gold mist is coherent across screens, but reveal and research samples show bright smoke behind content; supplied motion evidence includes a pass and a subsequent pending rerun.
findings: Reduce smoke luminance behind reading content and verify reduced-motion behavior on physical devices.

limitations: This is a blind evaluation of the attached sheets and supplied runtime narrative; no source, other rounds, graders or external task state were inspected.
All functional grades are provisional: supplied browser results support specific exercised paths but do not establish unobserved interactions.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, haptics, real payments, social/auth backend and OS sharing remain unverified.
Synthetic forecast and explanation text establish layout behavior only; no predictive quality or all-domain semantic quality is inferred.
Transition pairs show sampled composition and opacity, not full temporal continuity; the latest narrative says a motion rerun is pending after a preceding candidate passed.
Reported zero overflow, axe results and synthetic constrained-viewport checks do not prove readable native keyboard layouts or complete accessibility.
No screenshot establishes a blocked core task or data loss; below-fold and scrolled content is not automatically classified as unreachable.
Null is used only for genuinely inapplicable dimensions; missing interaction evidence receives a provisional numeric score.

For each item, A is the mean of applicable hierarchy, typography and surfaces scores; F is the mean of applicable clarity, feedback and accessibility scores; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal.
The authorized A≥9 and F≥9 threshold is not met, and the supplied native and assistive evidence cannot support 9/10 certification.
topFixes: Make enlarged custom answers wrap and verify real keyboard, caret and focus visibility on a physical phone.
Keep forecast text on a quieter background with readable contrast throughout transitions.
Ensure fixed headers and the raised navigation orb cannot obscure enlarged or focused content.
Add explicit selected-state feedback to answer choices and non-color selection to Sky topics.
Improve unavailable-omen recovery and prioritize support within sensitive redirects.
Complete physical screen-reader, native text enlargement, reduced-motion and keyboard checks before reconsidering certification.
